description: A person resumes a stopped loop (S55 T5, LC3) that has a PARKED step: the daemon cold-restarts that step from its checkpoint through the step-continue seam (the person's message, if any, reaches the transcript exactly once), then compare-and-set moves the loop back to running with a fresh runner. how is the daemon's decision, reported so the client is never guessing which resume a parked loop got: "step" here, "runner" for a between-steps stop or a watchdog stuck-block.

params.message: carry on — the goal is the new one
